caption: Castello di Toblino, Calavino
composition: Medieval castle on a wooded lake peninsula mirrored in still water · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The castle stands on its wooded peninsula at the center, its towers and roofs perfectly mirrored in the glassy lake that fills the foreground, with sheer grey Dolomite peaks rising behind. Dense green trees flank the castle on both sides, and the sky is a flawless 13:31 blue. The double image — stone above, reflection below — is the picture's whole pleasure.
